_readme: SAMPLE DATA for building and testing. Every entry with sample=true is a placeholder, not a real program. Leya replaces these with 10 to 12 verified Boston-area services. Keep the same fields. last_verified must be the date someone actually confirmed the entry by phone or official website.

services.name: SAMPLE Volunteer Medical Escort Program
services.how_to_use: Book at least 2 weeks before the procedure. A trained volunteer rides with you and stays until you are settled at home.

services.name: SAMPLE Council on Aging Medical Rides
services.waitlist_note: Rides fill up. Call as soon as you have a date.
services.how_to_use: Call to register, then book each ride ahead of time.

services.name: SAMPLE Paid Companion Escort Service
services.how_to_use: Hourly fee. A trained companion picks you up and stays with you.

services.name: SAMPLE Neighborhood Volunteer Drivers
services.how_to_use: Drivers take you to appointments within the city.

services.name: SAMPLE Utility Medical Needs Registration
services.how_to_use: Ask your electric company about registering a medical need. It can mean protection from shutoff and priority contact during outages.

services.name: SAMPLE Low-Cost Pet Boarding
services.how_to_use: Short stays for healthy cats and dogs. Book ahead. Cannot take pets that need medication or special care.

services.name: SAMPLE Senior Home Repair Program
services.waitlist_note: Non-emergency repairs can take several weeks.
services.how_to_use: Call to ask if you qualify. Emergency heating repairs may be faster.
